quest.title: Petal-Lit Ships Fish For the Moon
quest.description: Ningguang seems to be thinking about something...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Immaculate Talisman x200, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

chapter.num: Fleeting Colors in Flight: The Roiling Waves Hide Pearls From Sight
chapter.title: Petal-Lit Ships Fish For the Moon

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Beidou is salvaging some of my Jade Chamber collection out of the sea around Guyun Stone Forest. If that sounds like your idea of fun, you should go pay her a visit.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: A great many things are still unaccounted for...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Things like what?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: The new Jade Chamber is missing many of the contents held by its predecessor.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: All the literature, furniture, and ornaments I had collected followed the original Jade Chamber to its watery grave...

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Most of it was destroyed in the process, and the small handful of items that survived intact are strewn across the water's surface. Reclaiming them is taxing work.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: It takes someone with sturdy sea legs to handle this job, but even then... I just can't tell whether Beidou will be able to fish out everything herself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Fish out"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, so you made Beidou go and fish your stuff out of the sea for you?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: To claim that I "made" her do anything would be imprecise. We reached a mutually beneficial agreement, as is always the case in our dealings.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You pay Beidou to run errands for you?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Payment is one aspect of it. But I also compensate her in other ways... Hehe, let's just say it's a little complicated.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Anyway, Beidou is currently in the Guyun Stone Forest area.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: If you're interested, go pay her a visit. You may be just the help she needs.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Ugh, Ningguang... you're really trying my patience...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, but if the Jade Chamber smashed into smithereens when it hit the sea, then so did everything inside it. Just because I know the ocean doesn't mean I have the power to fish up the past...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...The salvaging is going pretty smoothly, then?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Oh, Traveler. What're you doing out this way?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm here to help out.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Great! You couldn't have picked a better time. The whole fleet's caught up with other things right now, so I'll take all the help I can get.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Look, I even had to rope Xinyan into this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Whoa, Xinyan's here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, what's the occasion? Did you come all the way out here to do a performance?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: You bet I did! Nothing official, mind you. Beidou wanted to hold a feast onboard and I agreed to come play a couple o' tunes.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: But all that went out the window when someone showed up saying they were one of Ningguang's secretaries. They called Beidou away.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: I think it was Baiwen, or Baixiao...? Ugh, well it was Bai-something.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Anyway. Ningguang apparently came up with the bright idea of me going out on the sea and salvaging a bunch of her old valuables. She seems pretty willing to shell out for it, too.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Hmph... Well, at the end of the day, the price was right. So yeah, we took the work.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Now, if we're gonna go trawling for trinkets, we're gonna need a smaller vessel.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: All the available boats have been dispatched already. But by the looks of it, we're still one short...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have my own boat.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: So you have your own vessel do ya? Hah! Great, let's take yours, then.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: The more people we have on this job the better. 'Cause the sooner we get this wrapped up, the sooner we can get that feast going and actually enjoy the festival!

talks.objective: Head to the designated location to board your Waverider
Head to the designated location to board your Waverider
Go to the waters near Guyun Stone Forest to commence salvaging

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Seems like the Treasure Hoarders are more of a mixed bag than I thought...

talks.objective: Defeat all opponents and claim your salvage

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Huh? Why're they heading back to shore?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: To reconvene with their posse, I'll bet.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Speed it up a notch, Traveler. This is a chase now.

dialogues.speaker: Carmen
dialogues.text: Stop! All of you!

dialogues.speaker: Carmen
dialogues.text: Are you blind? Can't you see this is Captain Beidou!?

dialogues.speaker: Carmen
dialogues.text: Hehe... Cap'n Beidou, it's been a while. Still fighting fit, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: I guess it has been a while, Carmen. You're looking a little worse for wear.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Maybe if you did your own dirty work rather than dispatching your minions, you wouldn't be so out of breath right now.

dialogues.speaker: Carmen
dialogues.text: Ah, how you jest, Beidou, very amusing... Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: To get serious for a second, though — I'm gonna be needing all of this. So put everything down and I won't cause you any more trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Carmen
dialogues.text: Of course, of course, whatever Cap'n Beidou wants... You heard her, people. Drop the goods!

dialogues.speaker: Carmen
dialogues.text: Here you are, it's all here. So, uh... w—we'll take our leave now.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Carmen dashes away with the Treasure Hoarders...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, he did what we asked without a second thought...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He couldn't surrender quickly enough.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Couldn't run off quickly enough, either...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Don't waste any more time on them. We've still got salvaging to do.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Ah, but we should load this stash onto the boat first... C'mon, Traveler, help me out here.

talks.objective: Move the goods onboard your Waverider

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: I wonder what's taking Sea Drake so long... Could he have run into the Treasure Hoarders, too?

talks.objective: Board your Waverider to continue the salvaging operation

dialogues.text: C'mon, we gotta wrap this up soon! Leave the junk, take anything and everything of value!
And I need a few of you to go and load the boat up, move it!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Whatever you're about to do — don't. And whatever goods you're holding — they're mine now.
B—Beidou!? Wh—What are you doing here!?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: I might ask you the same question.

dialogues.speaker: Liuliu
dialogues.text: I mean, what does it look like? We got lucky. Found some treasure floating around in the ocean.

dialogues.speaker: Liuliu
dialogues.text: If you see anything you like, it's yours for the taking! A token of our esteem for the mighty Captain Beidou, hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Is that right? Well, good. I'll take it all.

dialogues.speaker: Liuliu
dialogues.text: I... But... C'mon, heh, be reasonable here...

dialogues.speaker: Liuliu
dialogues.text: Me and the guys have been busting a gut gathering all this up... you gotta leave us a little something-something, surely?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Lemme make this crystal clear: These things do not belong to you, and they never will. So you're gonna put them down, and then you're gonna get as far away from me as is physically possible.

dialogues.speaker: Liuliu
dialogues.text: That's a little, uh... Heh, why don't we start over, huh? You see, we—

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Huh... sounds a lot like you're stalling to me.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Talk is cheap. Let's settle this the old-fashioned way!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Boy, they sure ran off quickly...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Eh, who cares. They didn't take anything with them.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: The bigger problem here is, there's no way all of this is going to fit onto your boat.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Hmm... Okay, here's what we're gonna do. Unload the boat and put everything here, in one place.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Based on the original plan, Sea Drake's boat should be coming past here at some point. When they get here, we'll hitch a ride with them.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: In the meantime, Traveler, head back to the Jade Chamber and deliver a message to Ningguang for me.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Just tell her we're almost done fishing for trinkets here, so she should start getting my compensation ready.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got it.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Alright. Thanks, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: If both Carmen and Liuliu were here... Then I wonder if that other "boss" of theirs, Big Sis, is snooping around?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: I've gotta tell Sea Drake and the rest of the crew to stay on high alert...

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Welcome back. I trust Beidou is making good progress on salvaging the items?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me fill you in...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You bring Ningguang up to speed on the events so far...

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Treasure Hoarders, I see... Yes, I can imagine that must have been rather irksome.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: It sounds like you scared them off on this occasion. But it won't end there. They are not the type to forgive and forget.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: You needn't concern yourself with them any further, though. Leave them to Beidou — she is well versed in handling Treasure Hoarders. I will be sure to make preparations for her compensation.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I also owe you my thanks for coming all this way to deliver Beidou's message. Here, please take this as a token of my appreciation.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Now, please excuse me, I have other business that demands my attention. I wish you a fun-filled festival.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: So... this is it? This is your boat?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: It's really, uh... compact. But, it works... It's about the right size for sweeping up junk from the water's surface.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Only thing is... we're packed in like sardines here. There's nowhere to put my guitar...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Uh, Xinyan, your "axe" is getting a little too close for comfort...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Oh! Whoops! Lemme try to move that out of your way...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Huh? Umm Xinyan, why does your guitar have blades on it?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Self-defense, of course! It shoots fire, too! ...Oh, but the middle of a big festival probably isn't the best time to give you a demonstration...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Also, there's a teeny-tiny chance it might set your boat on fire... That's not a risk worth taking, no matter how small...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, this gal really jazzed up her guitar...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hold up, are those... Treasure Hoarders!?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: We don't usually see these guys out at sea... Could they be here for the same reason as us?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: C'mon, Traveler. Steer us a little closer.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hey! There're some things floating on the water...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Hmm, I can't quite make out what they are. Let's bring them in and take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: I'll take the rudder. Traveler, Xinyan — go reel them in.
